title: Ultrahuman shrinking store header
description: A white store header under a one-line notice: menu and four small links on the left, a bold italic wordmark in the centre, region pill, bag and a blue buy button on the right. As the page scrolls the notice slides away and the full-width bar shrinks into a centred, translucent, blurred pill 13px from the top with only the brand mark left. On phones: mark, text buy link, region dot, bag and menu, turning translucent on scroll.
notes: the morph is CSS scroll-driven (scroll(root)): no JavaScript; without support or with reduced motion it stays a full-width bar
sticky, and takes its own height (32px notice + 45/57px bar) in the flow
the menu is a native details element
